_comment: Pi settings for gufo-agent-eval, copied verbatim into the per-run config
directory. Versioned, and hashes into the suite identity.
#153 requires unrelated extensions, skills, saved sessions, telemetry,
and implicit providers to be disabled. The environment variables the
runner sets (PI_OFFLINE, PI_SKIP_VERSION_CHECK, PI_TELEMETRY) cover the
network side; this file covers what Pi would otherwise load from disk.
